name: local-gate-advisory-severity
title: Let the local gate release advisory findings by severity, and disposition a miscited one
description: The local review gate reads only an outstanding count, so a low-severity observation blocks a merge exactly as a high-severity defect does, and a finding whose cited line does not contain the described code has no disposition but a plain rebuttal. Add a policy-owned advisory severity ceiling with a hard high-severity floor, and a miscited disposition ground.
creator: sdelmas
